description: One row per US street address, in the order given (never sorted by Score): Buildability Score, band, the landmine caps that bound it, FEMA flood zone at the address point, zoning district, and whether the district's dimensional standards are on record (yes/no), each with its source and read date, plus links. Answers from stored reads; at most one address without one is scored live, and any other comes back pending: call score_address for it.

properties.description: One to five properties being researched: US street addresses, e.g. "412 Oak St, Austin, TX".

name: compare_addresses

rows.description: One row per input address, in input order.

flood_read.description: False when the stored run has no live FEMA read: zone is then null, not X.

title: Compare up to five addresses
